rejectedTopics: Factory audit — a dedicated multilingual factory-evaluation guide already owns the intent.
Incoterms and landed cost — existing guides already own commercial and logistics cost intent.
Failed inspection — a dedicated corrective-action guide owns post-inspection containment and disposition.
Warranty claims — a dedicated multilingual owner covers field-claim evidence and recurrence control.
Container planning — the prior run already owns quantity, mass, geometry, securing and unloading.
siteGaps: No page owned the pre-production relationship among document hierarchy, approved product baseline, responsibility matrix, outsourced processes, change approval, release evidence and limited deviation authority.

sources.title: ISO 9001 Auditing Practices Group — External Providers
sources.use: Authoritative guidance for defining external-provider criteria, monitoring, verification and risk-based controls without claiming that one template fits every supplier.

sources.use: Official standards page checked for edition status; the article avoids asserting a universal clause set or unverified certification.
